text:
Evan (PM): Quick design review: we got feedback that reordering rules is confusing on keyboard-only flow and validation messages are too technical. Wanted to collect ideas for microcopy + keyboard affordances.

Luz (Design): Noted. Two parts: 1) make drag handle hint visible on focus, 2) show inline ordinal numbers next to rules (1, 2, 3) so users can see order without opening a menu. Microcopy: instead of 'Priority conflict' maybe 'Order conflict 1 rule overlap'.

Theo (Frontend): For keyboard: support focus on handle, Space/Enter to pick up, Up/Down to move, Esc to cancel. Will add an on-screen hint: 'Space to pick up, ↑/↓ to move'. Also will render a transient sr-only announcement: 'Picked up rule X; use arrow keys to move.'

Rina (A11y): +1. Use aria-grabbed or aria-pressed? aria-grabbed is deprecated. Use aria-pressed? Better: role=grid or listbox with aria-activedescendant and an aria-live region for announcements. Example SR phrase: 'Rule 4 moved to position 2 of 6'. Keep it short. Also ensure contrast of the focused handle meets 4.5:1.

Omar (Research): From sessions, users misinterpret 'No simulation output' as a failure. Proposed copy: 'No matches found 1 Try running sample traffic or relax conditions.' Add a subtle info icon with hover text: 'Sample traffic uses canned requests; simulated traffic may differ from live.'

Luz (Design): For the validation drawer, show severity levels: Info / Warning / Error using colored badges and an accessible label. Microcopy suggestions:
- Warning: 'Order unclear 1 Some rules may intercept traffic intended for others.'
- Error: 'Circular ordering detected 1 Open diagnostics.'
- Info: 'No issues detected.'

Theo (Frontend): We'll need endpoints to return diagnostics with suggested fixes. For auto-fix copy, avoid jargon: 'Auto-arrange rules to remove conflicts' + confirm modal: 'This will renumber rules. You can undo.' Add undo toast.

Rina (A11y): Undo toast must be keyboard-focusable and announced: 'Rules auto-arranged. Undo.' Provide aria-live=assertive for the toast. Also ensure modal has role=dialog and focus trap.

Evan (PM): How do we want to surface which rule changed after auto-arrange? Users want to jump to changed rule.

Luz (Design): Add a small 'View changes' link in the toast that opens a diff overlay showing before/after order and highlights moved rules. Copy: 'View changes' and overlay title 'Rule order changes'.

Omar (Research): In the next round, test whether 'Auto-arrange' vs 'Suggest arrangement' language affects trust. People prefer agency, so maybe 'Suggest arrangement' with an accept button is better. But that adds friction.

Theo (Frontend): Implementation note: for reduced-motion prefs, skip the reorder animation and use instant reposition. Also add aria-relevant updates only when content changes.

Rina (A11y): For drag handles, include aria-label: 'Reorder rule: {ruleName}; position {i} of {n}'. For keyboard move confirmation announce 'Moved to {k} of {n}'. For the preview controls: label primary 'Run sample input' secondary 'Run simulated traffic (ephemeral)'.

Luz (Design): Small copy tweak for the preview empty state: 'No traffic matched. Try sample input or widen conditions.' Keep it active-voice.

Evan (PM): Ok final-ish decisions to lock for this sprint:
- Keyboard reorder: Space to pick, arrows to move, Esc cancel. Announce pickup and new position.
- Inline ordinals visible next to each rule.
- Validation types: Info/Warning/Error with the suggested microcopy above.
- Auto-arrange workflow: change to 'Suggest arrangement' that opens a review modal; primary CTA 'Apply suggestion' + secondary 'Cancel'; toast with 'Undo' + 'View changes'.
- Preview buttons: 'Run sample input' and 'Run simulated traffic' with tooltip about ephemerality.

ci-bot: preview build ready: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/2209876543 :white_check_mark:

Omar (Research): I'll test 'Suggest arrangement' vs 'Auto-arrange' on 8 users next week and report back.

Theo (Frontend): I'll open PR with keyboard handlers and toast behavior. ETA EOW.

Rina (A11y): I'll write acceptance criteria for keyboard reorder + modal + toast announcements and share in the ticket.

Luz (Design): I'll update Figma with ordinals and the validation drawer visuals.

Evan (PM): Thanks team. Locking copy in issue: 'Order unclear 1 Some rules may intercept traffic intended for others.'
